messages.title: A message from Kenneth
messages.body:
Hello, this is Kenneth.

I see i finally have gotten some users for my app.
I hope everyone decides to keep using Neo-Lib, tell your friends about it,
and if you do have issues or find bugs, please report them in the "Feedback" button top left in the app.
Feel free to also come with suggestions about Neo-Lib!
